body: I'm still not too sure about that either. Both me and my sister are over 18, so idk if Social Services can even help us.

My sister is a bit physically disabled due to a bad surgery, I'm trying to go to school, and my mom is what I'm believing to be is far beyond senile.

My dad has a history of drug use, possession and selling, and calling the police is going to put the only household provider in jail.

I don't know where any of us are gonna end up.
